constraints.description: Exactly one workflow owns Pages upload and deployment.

validation.validation_method: Real-tree publisher discovery plus missing and competing publisher controls

constraints.description: The website build uses the frozen npm contract without invoking another package manager or changing the lockfile.

validation.validation_method: Package script inspection, mismatch control, and lockfile diff

constraints.description: Rust and TypeScript generated entrypoints are both required and copied without placeholder or fail-open fallback.

validation.validation_method: Two failing missing-output controls, one successful staging control, and workflow marker controls

constraints.description: The Pages workflow contains artifact generation, deployment, and deployed-route validation but no routine development checks.

validation.validation_method: GitHub Actions policy validator and parsed workflow inspection

constraints.description: Strict OpenSpec and scoped diff pass, while build and live deployment remain explicitly unverified until the final phase gate.

validation.validation_method: Strict OpenSpec, diff audit, and row-form verification limits

global_rules: Do not run routine tests in GitHub Actions.
Do not create placeholder generated references.
Do not run the full site gate before all documentation content is complete.
Do not claim live deployment without observed public routes.
termination_conditions: All blocking implementation constraints have observed local evidence.
Refiner schemas and strict OpenSpec pass.
The review clearly separates structural evidence from deferred build and deployment evidence.
